answer: An echo returns only what another sent, so credit must trace to a source. Each identity needs two holders outside its own grove to countersign the original call, and one countersignature backs one identity, so n aliases need n distinct witnesses instead of a single ring. Every sonnet of sealed work is priced by rank: the k-th stanza an operator files costs k squared in bond, so a farm pays near n cubed while still requiring unrelated guarantors. An audit replays a random stanza each epoch, and an unconfirmed one voids the whole grove and forfeits its bonds.
